Dots render immediately in dot mode (7x7 square = 49 circles verified). Save flow fully functional: save-confirm-btn now INSIDE viewport (bbox y=776, bottom=828, vh=844) — iteration-3 off-viewport bug is FIXED by the explicit window-height on web Modal wrapper in both SaveSheet and ColorWheelSheet. Toast 'Saved on device' displayed. localStorage key 'rangoli.artworks.v1' persisted (542 bytes). ColorWheelSheet: color-wheel bbox {x:55,y:432,w:280,h:280,inView:true}; apply btn {x:213,y:780,inView:true}; tap on wheel updated hex to #80F20D; Apply closed sheet and canvas-custom-swatch appeared. Exit flow verified: unsaved -> canvas-exit-sheet opens, cancel keeps drawing, save routes home after save. Gallery flow: item visible, delete-confirm shown, after delete gallery-empty rendered. ZERO /api network calls intercepted across whole session (fully offline confirmed). Join dots is default in dot mode; canvas-tool-toggle-btn toggles to Brush. Deprecated warnings detected (non-blocking, consistent with iteration 3 note): 'shadow* style props deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.'

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking per instructions but should be migrated. Reference: inspect any component using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius (likely glass/card styles).

Warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/canvas.tsx:195 uses pointerEvents="box-none" as a prop; migrate to style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}.

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and move 'pointerEvents' prop to style.pointerEvents in canvas.tsx:195. Non-blocking.
No functional fixes required. All reported bugs (drawing, dot rendering, save-on-device choice, delete-on-exit, color wheel apply, gallery delete/empty) are resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: SaveSheet.tsx:29 and ColorWheelSheet.tsx:81 both apply `Platform.OS === 'web' && { height: winH }` to bound Modal content to viewport — this is the correct fix and visibly resolves the iteration-3 layout bug.

DrawingCanvas.tsx uses onStartShouldSetResponder/onResponderGrant/Move/Release with pageX/pageY and useWindowDimensions-based screen size; mouse drag on web successfully creates strokes (verified <path> count = 1).
api.ts update(id,...) preserves id (no duplicate); gallery delete flow writes back without the removed id (verified via gallery-empty appearing after single-item delete).
Iteration-3 blocker is fully resolved: both modals report inView:true for all critical interactive elements on 390x844 viewport.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-scope flows — draw, save, toast, home-recent, persistence, gallery, delete, gallery-empty, color wheel pick+apply+custom swatch, exit sheet (save/delete/cancel), dot mode default (square 49 dots), join-dots -> Brush toggle
